opening: I get short of breath when I exert myself.
I get short of breath when I lie flat.
I wake up at night short of breath.
All of this started about a week ago.
Four weeks ago I had heart bypass surgery, with grafts to two arteries (the LAD and the posterior descending artery).
In the same operation my aortic valve was replaced with a tissue (bioprosthetic) valve.
I have coronary artery disease in several arteries.

opening.text: I had heart bypass surgery four weeks ago, where they put grafts on my LAD and posterior descending artery and replaced my aortic valve with a tissue valve. I have coronary artery disease in several arteries. About a week ago, I started getting short of breath when I exert myself, when I lie flat, and I wake up at night short of breath. I've also been swelling up.
